categories.main_business_segments: Melco International primarily operates in the casino and hospitality sector through its subsidiary Melco Resorts, which develops, owns, and operates integrated resort facilities in Asia and Europe. Key properties include City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha Clubs in Macau, City of Dreams Manila in the Philippines, City of Dreams Mediterranean in Cyprus, and the upcoming City of Dreams Sri Lanka. The Group also has investments in joint ventures and associates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group leverages cutting-edge entertainment technologies, such as immersive aquatic shows with advanced stagecraft (e.g., House of Dancing Water), Dolby Cinema technology, and large-scale interactive LED installations. It employs proprietary gaming operations and hospitality management systems, including smart baccarat tables and electronic gaming machines, to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Melco International serves high-end and mass-market gaming customers, including VIP rolling chip patrons and mass market visitors primarily in Macau, the Philippines, Cyprus, and Sri Lanka. The Group targets affluent and experience-seeking tourists, regional Asian markets, and local communities, with a focus on leisure, entertainment, and integrated resort experiences.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Macau, the Philippines, Cyprus, Sri Lanka, Hong Kong, and Singapore. Its core market is Macau, with significant operations in Cotai and Taipa, and it is expanding into emerging markets such as Sri Lanka and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Melco International operates primarily downstream in the leisure and entertainment supply chain as a developer, owner, and operator of integrated resorts and casinos. It manages customer-facing services including gaming, hospitality, entertainment, and retail, while also engaging with suppliers and local SMEs to support its operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group focuses on strategic expansion with an asset-light approach, innovation in entertainment offerings, and enhancement of customer experience through technology and cultural attractions. Sustainability and ESG integration are core priorities, with commitments to carbon neutrality, zero waste, and responsible gaming. R&D efforts include adopting new entertainment technologies and refining marketing strategies using data from smart gaming tables.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through casino gaming operations (table games, electronic gaming machines, VIP and mass market segments), hospitality services (rooms, food and beverage), entertainment, retail, and leasing of mall spaces. The Group also earns income from management fees and licensing in certain markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Melco International positions itself as a leading integrated resort operator in Asia and Europe, competing with other major casino and hospitality groups in Macau, the Philippines, and emerging markets. It emphasizes premium and differentiated entertainment experiences to maintain a competitive edge. The Group holds a majority stake in Melco Resorts, a key player in the gaming industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported net revenues of HK$36.17 billion, a 22.5% increase from 2023, driven by tourism recovery and new property openings. Adjusted EBITDA was HK$9.03 billion. The Group recorded a loss attributable to owners of HK$0.78 billion, an improvement from the prior year. Total assets were HK$84.75 billion with liabilities of HK$76.54 billion. The Group is growing its global footprint with new projects like City of Dreams Sri Lanka.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Melco International differentiates itself through world-class integrated resorts offering unique entertainment experiences, such as the House of Dancing Water aquatic show and Macau’s first Dolby Cinema. It combines premium gaming with diverse leisure, cultural, and sporting events to attract high-value customers. The Group emphasizes sustainability, responsible gaming, and community engagement as part of its value proposition.
